Hey Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC environment setup. I pulled out the technical dependencies we agreed on and suggested owners and target dates so we can align expectations.

High level (please confirm):
- Goal: 2-week POC to validate latency and model quality from Acme VPC -> Redwood Dedicated private endpoint.
- Target close for POC readiness: 2026-05-15

Key MAP milestones included in the attached spreadsheet (redwood-map-draft.xlsx):
1) Network & connectivity: VPC peering / PrivateLink or customer-managed NAT, IP allowlists configured on both sides. (Owner: Acme infra engineering, Redwood infra to provide egress IPs and peering guide)
2) Identity & access: SAML SSO for test users + service account for API access. (Owner: Acme IdP + Redwood SRE)
3) Secrets & KMS: KMS key for model artifacts and secrets integration for API keys. (Owner: Acme security + Redwood eng)
4) Test data & sampling: Provide sample dataset (anonymized) + test prompts. (Owner: Acme product)

Dependencies we called out: SAML metadata file from Acme, CIDR range for VPC peering, static egress IPs for allowlist, and confirmation of KMS approach (bring-your-own vs Redwood-managed).

Next steps for this week:
- Acme: share SAML metadata and CIDR (Samir) by Tue 2026-05-04
- Redwood: provide VPC peering guide and egress IPs (Nikhil) by Mon 2026-05-03
- Redwood: update MAP with explicit test plans and acceptance criteria (Marissa) by Wed 2026-05-06

I've attached the MAP draft and a simple network diagram (POC_NETWORK_DIAGRAM.pdf). Let me know if owners or dates need to change.

Thanks —
Marissa

Hi Samir / Priya —

Short answers from the infra side:
- BYOK: Yes, Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys for encrypting customer secrets in Private deployments and can support a BYOK workflow for the POC. We'll need the key ARN and a cross-account grant for the Redwood service principal. We'll send a short checklist for the KMS grant.
- Networking: For a short POC we recommend PrivateLink (AWS VPC endpoint) when available — it avoids full peering and is easier to unwind. If you prefer peering we can support that too; we'll provide the peering steps.
- Egress IPs / allowlist: Attached in the VPC guide are our recommended egress IPs and staging ranges. We'll publish a small firewall rule sample for your infra team to apply.

I'll drop the VPC peering / PrivateLink guide into the shared Drive link by EOD Mon (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D/view).

Action items (tech):
- Redwood (Nikhil): publish VPC guide + egress IPs by 2026-05-03
- Acme (Samir): share SAML metadata + CIDR by 2026-05-04
- Acme (Priya): confirm test user list and sampling by 2026-05-05
